page.title: Module settings
page.description: Parameters of the modules in this build. Changes take effect after saving. No module declares configurable parameters right now — the page stays empty until one does.

error.save_failed: Some settings couldn't be saved — see the field errors.

module.no_fields: This module has no user settings.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Applied immediately, saved in this browser

app.title: Interface
app.description: How the app itself looks and behaves: interface language, theme and font.

document.title: Document appearance
document.description: How the reading zone is set — bodies of tasks, plan stages and journal entries. The interface around it is not affected.

code.title: Code block appearance
code.description: Code blocks inside document bodies: what they are set in and how they read next to the text.

diagram.title: Diagrams
diagram.description: Diagrams inside document bodies: what the labels are set in, how the diagram sits in the text and how tall it may be.

page.title: Interface settings
page.description: How the app looks. Stored on the server and applied immediately — no need to save.

sync.failed: Couldn't save the interface settings — we'll try again.

language.label: Language
language.description: Interface language: labels, messages, date format. Text written in tasks is not translated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Light or dark scheme. “System” switches along with the operating system setting.

interface.label: Interface font
interface.description: Navigation, tables, forms, page titles — text that is scanned.

reading.label: Text font
reading.description: Bodies of tasks, plan stages and journal entries — text that is read through.

heading.label: Heading font
heading.description: Typeface for headings of every level. By default it is the text font; a separate typeface makes sense when headings should read as a different voice rather than as large text.

mono.label: Code font
mono.description: Code blocks, inline code and technical labels — everywhere letters must sit on a grid.

diagram.label: Diagram font
diagram.description: Labels inside diagrams. The layout measures block widths with Inter metrics — with another typeface a long label may not fit.

theme.label: Diagram palette
theme.description: “System” draws the diagram in the app's colors and switches along with its theme. A ready-made palette brings its own background and stays the same whether the app is light or dark.

align.label: Diagram position
align.description: Text is limited by the reading column, diagrams are not. Aligned left, a diagram lines up with the paragraphs.

height.label: Diagram height
height.description: Height cap inside a document body: a taller diagram is scaled down. It is examined in full screen anyway — by double click.

reading.label: Text size
reading.description: Base size of the reading zone. Headings, code and tables inside it scale along.

code.label: Code block font size
code.description: Listing size in document bodies. Monospace looks larger than text at the same size, so the block usually sits one step lower. Line numbers and padding inside the block follow.

reading.label: Text weight
reading.description: Weight of the text in the reading zone. Headings and emphasis inside keep their own weight. Not every typeface has weights lighter than regular — there 100–300 render as 400.

heading.label: Heading weight
heading.description: Weight of headings of every level. Sections read through the contrast with the text weight — the smaller it is, the more even the page and the harder it is to find where a section starts.

reading.label: Paragraph width
reading.description: Limit of the text column. Tables, code blocks and images are not bound by it — they take the full width.

variant.label: Code block style
variant.description: What surrounds the listing: the language label and buttons. A one-line block is not affected — it is always drawn as a command strip without a header.

line_numbers.label: Line numbers in code blocks
line_numbers.description: How a listing opens in a document body. The button in the block's own header stays: it turns numbers on or off in one listing without touching this setting.

light.label: Light
light.note: The same set of colors, turned onto a light background.

system.label: System
system.note: Follows the operating system setting and switches along with it.

icon.label: Header with icons
icon.note: Language label on the left, line-number and copy icons on the right.

accent.label: Header with a button
accent.note: The same language label, but copying is a visible labelled button.

minimal.label: No header
minimal.note: Just highlighted code: no language, no buttons. Copy by selecting.

left.label: Left
left.note: The diagram lines up with the text around it.

center.label: Center
center.note: More prominent, but a narrow diagram drifts away from the text column.

system.label: System
system.note: The app's colors: the diagram switches along with its theme.

tokyo-night-storm.note: The same palette on a lighter background.

tokyo-night-light.note: A light version of the same palette.

onest.note: A grotesque built around Cyrillic. The app's default font.

golos.note: Drawn for reading Russian text rather than for interfaces. The family has no italics.

ibm-plex-sans.note: Cyrillic drawn by Alexandra Samulenkova. The only one here with Bulgarian letterforms.

pt-sans.note: Made for the languages of Russia: the widest Cyrillic coverage and a true italic.

commissioner.note: A humanist grotesque; Cyrillic consulted by Maria Doreuli.

geologica.note: Wide proportions and open apertures — what helps readers with low vision.

literata.note: A screen serif for long reading (the Google Play Books typeface).

pt-serif.note: A serif from the same family as PT Sans; experts rate its Cyrillic even higher.

source-serif.note: A screen serif with an optical size axis; better Cyrillic than its Source Sans pair.

lora.note: A calligraphic serif; the widest set of localized Cyrillic letterforms.

piazzolla.note: Optical size axis 8–30 pt: letterforms adapt to the type size.

spectral.note: The Google Docs serif; Cyrillic drawn by Ilya Ruderman and Yury Ostromentsky.

jetbrains-mono.note: Drawn for reading code: wide spacing, a distinct zero and letter O.

ibm-plex-mono.note: The monospace pair to IBM Plex Sans — if the interface is set in it too.

martian-mono.note: The only monospace with a width axis. It has no Serbian or Macedonian letters.

system-mono.label: System monospace
system-mono.note: Consolas, Menlo or a system substitute — nothing is downloaded.

system.label: System sans
system.note: The operating system font — nothing is downloaded.

system-serif.label: System serif
system-serif.note: Georgia or a system substitute — nothing is downloaded.

reading.label: Same as text
reading.note: Headings are set in the text font and change along with it.
